selection: First two lexicographically ordered works with a four-digit publication suffix1800..1899 in OCR-D/gt_structure_text inventory, then first ordinal GT-PAGE XML from each. Both cases retained if labels/images/recognition unsupported. Selection frozen before fetching source XML/images or any OCR.
identity_protocol: Fetch raw sources at the commit; verify each expected Git blob and bytecount from inventory. The inventory returned a root sha different from commit.tree.sha; file identity checks remain authoritative; do not infer exact tree consistency from root metadata.
scope: Original full historical scan images with independent PAGE text/geometry. If no publisher PDF exists, a lossless full-image PDF container must be explicitly labelled; no crop, selected line OCR, source correction or invented GT. Text references/scoring frozen before candidate. Training overlap of published model and OCR-D data unknown; development evidence, not heldout accuracy or PDFcompletion. No rawtranscriptions/images/models inGit.
